vibe_and_concept: High-End Cinematic Tech. Inspired by 'Floema', this design relies on 'Organic Flow' and 'Kinetic Typography'. Instead of rigid, sterile tech dashboards, we use smooth fluid motion, oversized and performative typography, and high-end deep cinematic textures to convey authority and modern AI/Cloud expertise.

rules: Never use pure black #000000, always use deep tinted obsidian #050505.
Primary text must have APCA / WCAG AA contrast. Use text-white/90 for main body, text-white for headings.
Avoid large blocks of flat accent colors. Accent (#00F0FF) should only be used for glowing borders (Tracing Beam), tiny data points, or hover states.
Headings must be performative: massive scale, tight tracking.
Do NOT use Inter or standard fonts for Headings.
Use mono fonts for technical metrics, stats, or overlines to ground the 'organic' feel in 'tech' reality.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid protocol: fluid and asymmetrical. Grid items should use col-span variations (e.g., col-span-4 vs col-span-8) to avoid boring symmetry.
rules: Generous spacing: use gap-8 or gap-12 between sections.
Cards must have generous internal padding (p-8 or p-12).
Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

motion_and_interaction.scroll: Smooth scrolling is MANDATORY. Implement Lenis for momentum-based scrolling.

animations.hero_text: Kinetic typography. Staggered letter/word reveal on load.
animations.scroll_reveals: Elements slide up and fade in (y: 40, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) on scroll using Framer Motion 'whileInView'.
animations.buttons: Magnetic effect or subtle scale (scale: 0.98 on tap, scale: 1.05 on hover).
animations.parallax: Use scroll-triggered parallax for background images.

component_styling.header: Crystal Glass variant: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10. Logo is typographical.
component_styling.buttons: High contrast. Primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200. Secondary: border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10. Include an arrow icon that translates right on hover.
component_styling.cards: Dark surface (bg-[#121212]) with 1px subtle inner border (border-white/5). Hover state: slight lift and subtle tracing glow.
component_styling.inputs: Shadcn based but highly customized. bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 rounded-none focus:border-white focus:ring-0 text-white. No default white blocks.
component_styling.marquee: Slow, smooth, seamless loop using react-fast-marquee. Use react-icons/si for actual brand SVGs (AWS, Azure, React, Python, Docker).

home.hero: Cinematic dark hero. Massive kinetic typography ('WE BUILD DIGITAL FUTURES'). Background features abstract 3D dark tech image with subtle parallax. Overlay bg-black/40 to ensure text pops.
home.marquee: Client & Tech stack logos using React Icons (SiAmazonaws, SiMicrosoftazure, etc.) in grayscale/white.
home.services_bento: Asymmetrical grid showing Cloud, SaaS Development, AI/Data. Cards use hover glow effects.
home.stats: Large mono-font animated counters (e.g., '99.9% Uptime', '50+ Enterprise Clients').

services.layout: Deep dive into capabilities. Use alternate left/right overlapping layouts with rich imagery for Custom Software, DevOps, and AI.

about.layout: Company story. Large editorial text layout. Image of modern moody office/team.
about.vibe: Humanizes the tech. Focus on the organic 'Floema' inspiration here.

careers.layout: List of open positions using accordion/expandable rows. Clean, Swiss-style typography for readability.

contact.layout: Split layout. Left: massive text 'LET\'S TALK.'. Right: Minimalist, brutalist form (Shadcn customized) that sends real emails via backend API.

hero_abstract.description: Vivid dark 3D abstract render for main landing hero background

cloud_services.description: Server room glowing blue, for Cloud/DevOps section

office_team.description: Modern moody tech office for About/Careers section

ai_data_abstract.description: Smooth dark 3D wave for AI/Data background

media_assets.logo_instructions: DO NOT use image placeholders for tech/client logos. You MUST import icons from react-icons/si (e.g., SiAmazonaws, SiGooglecloud, SiReact, SiPython, SiDocker) and render them as white SVGs in the marquee.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (links, buttons, form inputs, toggles, accordions) MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case (e.g., 'home-hero-cta', 'contact-email-input').
testing_and_accessibility.accessibility: Ensure focus rings are styled correctly and screen readers can parse the bento grid logically.
